title: S0318 (2023 Regular): Conditions of Pretrial Release

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2023-01-23; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2023/318/BillText/Filed/HTML (LegiScan doc 2657799))
provenance.note: As-filed text (2023-01-23); no votes recorded. The gun-specific condition is the whole bill, so it is not counted as a separate bail subject.

operative_text: Section 1 (s. 903.047(3), F.S.): If a court orders a defendant to surrender his or her firearms or ammunition or prohibits a defendant’s possession of firearms or ammunition as a condition of pretrial release, it is a violation of this section for the defendant to have in his or her care, custody, possession, or control a firearm or any ammunition.
